description:
BROE auctioneers are delighted to present this superb Five-Bedroom detached dormer Bungalow on c. ¾ Acre. Nestled on the edge of the picturesque village of Blessington, this exceptional five-bedroom detached bungalow overlooking Blessington lakes offers a rare combination of generous living accommodation, substantial grounds and a highly convenient location. Set on approximately c. ¾ acre, this impressive home extends to approximately 320 sq. m. and is approached via electric gates and a gravel driveway, with mature, beautifully landscaped gardens providing a wonderful sense of privacy. The south-facing rear garden is a particular highlight, offering an ideal outdoor setting for relaxing and entertaining.
Internally, the property offers bright, spacious and versatile accommodation arranged over two floors. Upon entering, a welcoming large entrance hall provides access to the principal living spaces. Double doors lead into the elegant lounge, which in turn opens to a formal dining room featuring a charming window seat.
A standout feature of the home is the large, bright and spacious modern kitchen/dining area, designed as the heart of the property. The kitchen benefits from attractive granite worktops, generous storage and ample space for both everyday family living and entertaining.
The ground floor provides three bedrooms, including a generous principal bedroom with en-suite facilities and a walk-in wardrobe. A well-appointed family bathroom and laundry room completes the ground-floor accommodation.
Upstairs, the property continues to impress with a large living area featuring a wood-burning stove, creating a warm and inviting space ideal for relaxing or entertaining. There are also two further bedrooms, both benefiting from en-suite facilities, providing excellent accommodation for family members or guests.

The property enjoys an enviable position on the edge of Blessington Village, offering the perfect balance of peaceful surroundings, beautiful countryside and everyday convenience.

Blessington is a popular commuter town, ideally positioned for easy access to Citywest, the M50 and Dublin City Centre, making it an excellent choice for those seeking a tranquil setting while remaining within easy reach of the capital.

The property enjoys beautiful views towards Blessington Lakes, which provide an outstanding setting for walking, cycling and enjoying the surrounding countryside. The scenic lakes and rolling landscape create a wonderful backdrop to everyday life.

The village itself offers an excellent range of amenities, all within easy reach, including a selection of pubs, cafés, restaurants and eateries, churches, schools and a variety of local services and amenities.

Combining generous proportions, substantial private grounds, excellent accommodation and an enviable location, this impressive home represents a wonderful opportunity to acquire a truly special family residence in one of Wicklow's most sought-after commuter locations.
